method: Read-only review of the complete runtime diff, new auxiliary module, repair/persistence paths, test changes and callers according to review-agent. Reviewed by the implementation agent, not independently.
resolvedFindings: Prevent empty/damaged electrical systems from inheriting a warm running crank during recovery, tuning or save restoration.
Keep battery charge labels distinct from component failure; charging a failed battery cannot repair it.
Use the fitted native starter parameters for recovery and actual cranking checks.
Remove generator and weakened-starter loss share from the engine/oil extra-friction heat path.
Cut NOS torque when electrical ignition is unavailable.
visualCheck: Desktop and 390-pixel condition panel screenshots inspected; component labels, voltage/current/charge and isolated service buttons remain readable.
limits: Fictional lumped 12 V / 60 Ah system shared by the four cars; no battery chemistry, full wiring/fuse network or real-car calibration. Starter and generator thermal/electrical coupling is approximate, not a closed energy audit.
Active gameplay integrates charge. Pause, menus and service freeze the driving solver. Workshop charging is compressed to the existing service interval.
No visible engine bay yet. Remote cars do not receive complete electrical component state.

Final HTML covers persistence, tuning, new runs and diagnostics. Damaged-part service additionally uses original VehiclePanel/CarPhysics in a module harness, without main service timing or travel to the workshop.
Multiplayer uses local independent browser processes with real public PeerJS/WebRTC. Separate physical PCs, mobile networks and restrictive NAT/TURN are not tested.
No physical controller or subjective listening test. CPU sample excludes world/GPU/AI/audio and is not an FPS guarantee.
